craft_notes: Sthāyin: ascent-geometry (wheel-step + three fists). Sanskrit: udgacchantīṃ taḍitrūpām...muṣṭitrayaṃ yāvat → L4 keeps numbers literal. Rows: row 2 (three fists until). Close: rise (mahodaya echoes v28 — the word rhymes itself across verses: intentional refrain). Rejected: 'fingers' for muṣṭi — killed: fists (hand-measure); rounding to 'about three' — killed: exact number sung.

lines: Rising lightning-formed, wheel by wheel in step;
upward three fists — until: then at end, great rise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: udgacchantīṃ taḍitrūpām praticakraṃ kramāt kramam | ūrdhvaṃ muṣṭitrayaṃ yāvat tāvad ante mahodayaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How does it rise? → The rise steps wheel by wheel to three fists — then the great rise.
c1_essence: Lightning-rise, wheel by wheel to three fists: great rise.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness carrying resolve)
